hoy.titular: Palmeiras play at the Mineirão today and wait on Giay, Flaco López and Arias

foto.alt: Coaching staff give instructions to two players during a training session at City Bell.

hoy.resumen: The 1,000 extra seats for the final sold out in under an hour. Palmeiras visit Cruzeiro today with five players missing and are waiting on three internationals arriving on charter flights, while the Pincha keep preparing for the final without Baltasar Rodríguez.

siete.texto: The 1,000 category 2 seats (USD 250) that CONMEBOL put on sale on Tuesday via ElevenTickets, only for Banco Provincia Mastercard holders, sold out in under an hour. The site crashed and many fans who missed out complained.

They play at 20:30 at the Mineirão in the Brasileirão without Gustavo Gómez or Maurício (on Paraguay duty), Murilo, Piquerez or Paulinho. Giay, Flaco López and Jhon Arias played for their countries on Tuesday, arrive today on charter flights and will be assessed.

siete.titulo: Correa a doubt for the final
siete.texto: He is nursing a grade 2 tear in the biceps of his right leg and is still working apart from the group. Even if he is cleared, he will lack match rhythm: a starting place is far from certain.

siete.titulo: Without Baltasar, Medina weighs a back five
siete.texto: Baltasar Rodríguez, sent off against Flamengo at the Maracanã, will miss the final. According to El Día, the coach is considering five defenders at the Centenario to stop Palmeiras' full-backs getting forward.

CONMEBOL chose Venezuelan Jesús Valenzuela, with an all-Venezuelan crew and Juan Soto on VAR. He refereed the Pincha's 1-0 win over Corinthians in the quarter-finals; Palmeiras are unbeaten with him this year.
The club invited members of Sabella's squad that won the 2009 Libertadores. Leandro Benítez confirmed he will be at the Centenario: "I'm going to enjoy it, you don't play a final every day".

siete.titulo: Palmeiras have another final eight days later
siete.texto: On 6 December, eight days after Montevideo, Palmeiras face Grêmio in the Copa do Brasil final, a one-off match at the Mané Garrincha in Brasília. The CBF has not set the kick-off time yet.

linea.texto: The squad press on with their preparations for the final in Montevideo.
Cruzeiro and Palmeiras, second in the Brasileirão, meet today at the Mineirão with Verdão badly depleted.
Leandro Benítez, a 2009 champion, confirmed he will travel to Montevideo as the club's guest.
The women's team unveiled Mauro Silva as new head coach and a project running to 2030.
Jesús Valenzuela will referee the final between Estudiantes and Palmeiras at the Centenario.
The 1,000 extra seats for the final sold out in under an hour, amid website crashes and complaints.
Palmeiras wrapped up preparations for their trip to Cruzeiro with five absentees, Piquerez among them.
Palmeiras wrapped up preparations for Cruzeiro without their internationals: Murilo and Jefté target the final.
CONMEBOL opened an extra seat sale for the final, only for Banco Provincia Mastercard holders.
The Pincha could play January's Recopa de Campeones in La Plata; the venue is not yet confirmed.
Palmeiras await Giay, Flaco López and Arias, arriving on charter flights after international duty.
Operation Palmeiras is under way at City Bell: Medina is considering a back five.
Estudiantes trained again at City Bell after the title in Córdoba, with Palmeiras already in mind.
With the Supercopa trophy and plenty of joy, this is how preparations for the Libertadores final began.
